serve.cmd: unset ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE; test -n "$VERIFY_DATA_DIR" || { echo 'VERIFY_DATA_DIR is unset: refusing to start against the real cyboflow data directory' >&2; exit 78; }; CYBOFLOW_VERIFY_TOKEN=cyboflow-verify-cdp-v1 CYBOFLOW_DIR="$VERIFY_DATA_DIR" CYBOFLOW_VITE_PORT=${PORT} CYBOFLOW_CDP_PORT=$VERIFY_DRIVER_PORT pnpm run electron-dev

cdp-app.notes: Serve is package.json:60 'electron-dev' verbatim, driven through the three levers the project ALREADY reads: CYBOFLOW_VITE_PORT (package.json:60 -> frontend/vite.config.ts:121, strictPort:true at :124, and main/src/index.ts:875), CYBOFLOW_CDP_PORT (package.json:60 -> scripts/dev-electron.mjs:34 -> --remote-debugging-port), CYBOFLOW_DIR (main/src/utils/cyboflowDirectory.ts:115,142). CYBOFLOW_DIR is MANDATORY, not hygiene: the single-instance lock keys on the userData path derived from it (main/src/index.ts:886-906), so without it this instance silently loses to the developer's own pnpm dev and quits. --user-data-dir alone does NOT break the singleton. No 'web' entry: the renderer cannot bootstrap standalone without preload-injected electronTRPC (docs/VISUAL-VERIFICATION-SETUP.md). Attestation is the launch-token channel (main/src/preload.ts:293-295); 'expected' is a constant no release invalidates, unlike the old version-pinned electronAPI.getAppVersion() channel which also matched ANY running instance. PROVEN-ROUND LANDMINES (round 1): (1) clearing ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE is LOAD-BEARING -- the verification agent is itself hosted inside Electron, so ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 is INHERITED into serve; 'electron .' then runs as plain node and dies with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading getAppPath)', surfacing only as 'exited with code 1'. (2) The bundled driver's require('playwright') can be MODULE_NOT_FOUND from app.asar.unpacked, and its catch MASKS this as 'CDP endpoint not reachable on port N' even when the app is healthy. DO NOT set NODE_PATH yourself, and never point it at the snapshot's node_modules: the harness binds NODE_PATH to CYBOFLOW's OWN node_modules inside the $VERIFY_DRIVER wrapper (a deliverable-controlled playwright would BE the driver's implementation), and it is stripped again before the serve child inherits it. In a PACKAGED build no root resolves at all until node_modules/playwright** joins asarUnpack, so that message can still be a module-resolution failure there -- never read it as a serve failure without first curling the CDP port. SERVE-IDENTITY BINDING (round 2, PROVEN BY MEASUREMENT; both halves now ALSO handled harness-side, kept here for readability and for older harnesses): (a) 'unset ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE;' cleared the var this Electron-hosted agent leaks into serve -- driverCore.serveChildEnv now strips it (and NODE_PATH) before the child is spawned; (b) the ';' kept /bin/sh as the detached process-GROUP LEADER, because a single simple command -- including a plain 'CYBOFLOW_DIR=... pnpm run electron-dev' or any 'env -u ...' prefix -- is EXEC-OPTIMIZED by sh, the leader's argv becomes 'node .../pnpm run electron-dev', and serveCommandMatches fails with 'a substitute or a wrapper was started instead of the deliverable'. driverCore.serveShellInvocation now appends a trailing newline + ':' no-op that guarantees the same thing. VERIFY_DATA_DIR GUARD: the 'test -n' prelude is a hard stop, not hygiene -- CYBOFLOW_DIR falling through to an empty value makes getCyboflowDirectory (main/src/utils/cyboflowDirectory.ts:143) target the developer's REAL ~/.cyboflow_dev. PASS THIS COMMAND VERBATIM: substitute ${PORT} and nothing else -- every other $VAR must reach /bin/sh unexpanded or the pinned-command binding rejects the run. readyWhen.urlPath '/' is the Vite renderer root on ${PORT}; 180s covers a cold Vite prebundle plus the Vite readiness gate in scripts/dev-electron.mjs:50-66.

native-screen.notes: Same serve as cdp-app (including the VERIFY_DATA_DIR guard prelude -- pass it verbatim, substituting only ${PORT}): the OS chrome only exists while the app runs. attach:'cdp' is kept DELIBERATELY even though this modality captures via peekaboo, because it sets VERIFY_DRIVER_ATTACH_ONLY and stops the driver launching a blank chromium that would screenshot the wrong surface. titlePattern matches the verify-only title set at main/src/index.ts:418-428 (setAppTitle) and pinned against page-<title> mirroring at main/src/index.ts:1283-1287 -- an ordinary pnpm dev window keeps 'Cyboflow [worktree]' and cannot match. window-identity remains the WEAKEST attestation kind by contract (a title is spoofable), but it now discriminates instances. APP SELECTOR IS A BUNDLE ID, NOT A NAME (measured; do not 'simplify' back to 'Electron'): peekaboo resolves --app by FUZZY match over name AND bundle id, so 'Electron' matched com.superhuman.electron while cyboflow was not even running, and exited 1 with 'Ambiguous application identifier: Electron' whenever two Electron-family apps were live -- before any title comparison. com.github.Electron is the CFBundleIdentifier of the node_modules electron dist Electron.app, which is what an unpackaged pnpm dev launches. RESIDUAL: two concurrent com.github.Electron instances (two worktrees both running pnpm dev) may still be ambiguous at the APP-resolution step; titlePattern discriminates the WINDOW but cannot rescue a failed app lookup. Driver-side limitation, already filed as a finding.

levers.notes: cdpPortFlag is what 'electron .' receives; the runbook sets it indirectly via CYBOFLOW_CDP_PORT, which the launcher behind 'pnpm run electron-dev' (package.json:60) reads and forwards at scripts/dev-electron.mjs:30,34. dataDirEnv is CYBOFLOW_DIR and NOT --user-data-dir: the single-instance lock keys on the userData path derived from CYBOFLOW_DIR (main/src/index.ts:886-906). nonceEnv is deliberately NOT declared: the identity marker env var is CYBOFLOW_VERIFY_TOKEN (main/src/preload.ts:294), but the cdp-token kind requires a literal 'expected', so identity is pinned to the constant the serve command itself injects rather than to a per-request nonce. That constant is still per-INSTANCE discriminating (absent unless the launcher sets it) and is stable across releases. If a per-request nonce is ever wanted here, cdp-token's 'expected' contract has to change first.
